long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I have a clay bowl and a dish already, and a second piece of clay is worth more than a nap I have just had.
I will take one piece with empty paws and carry it home to put away.
Things I keep ought to be where I can see them, so the clay goes in the house.
From the lookout rock I can see the whole beach, and I prefer high places.

today.reason: The nap has already happened, so I am back to gathering clay for the collection.
